message.content: {"claims":[{"quote":"Our target customers are adults aged 26 to 47 who travel by ferry."},{"quote":"Ticket scans take 1.41 seconds on the Northgate to Saltmarsh gate."},{"quote":"Queue time at the Northgate to Saltmarsh kiosk rose 19% after the timetable change."},{"quote":"The Pier 4 to Gull Island service carried 5600 passengers last month."}],"needs":[],"stories":[{"quote":"As a freight clerks traveller, I want to be told of a delay so that I can rebook."},{"quote":"As a ticket inspector, I want to scan a code so that I can confirm a booking quickly."},{"quote":"As a ticket inspector, I want to scan a code so that I can confirm a booking quickly."},{"quote":"As a school parties traveller, I want to be told of a delay so that I can rebook."},{"quote":"As a day visitors traveller, I want to be told of a delay so that I can rebook."},{"quote":"As a ticket inspector, I want to scan a code so that I can confirm a booking quickly."},{"quote":"As an operator, I want to export sailings so that finance can reconcile them."}],"dependencies":[{"quote":"Sam Okoro on the payments gateway team will confirm the schedule feed by June."},{"quote":"We rely on the port authority's berth API for berth availability."},{"quote":"Sam Okoro on the port authority's berth API will confirm the schedule feed by June."},{"quote":"The service must meet the Maritime Passenger Records Act, section 12."},{"quote":"Passenger names must be retained for seven years under the operator's licence condition 7.3."},{"quote":"The service must meet the Maritime Passenger Records Act, section 12."}]}
